title: Tzurba Merabbanan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: It is a descriptive title for a Torah scholar (talmid chakham), and it is found a number of times in the Talmud.[^1]

notes.text: This is a descriptive designation for a Torah scholar, not the name or personal rank of an identified sage. ת״ח and ש״ס are rendered talmid chakham and Talmud; several occurrences is Hyman’s unenumerated statement, with no specific passages checked.
